shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null; git -C /workspace log --oneline -5
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo ---; ls /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo ---; ls /workspace/node_modules | head -60; echo ---; node -v; npm -v
npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest 2>&1 | tail -20
node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version, require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version)"

printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
.next/

# the local book store
data/
' > .gitignore && cat .gitignore && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -25
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "server up"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE 'Currently reading|Nothing on the go[^<]*|No finished books yet|Add a book'
curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o '<form[^>]*>.*</form>' | head -c 2000; echo; echo "=== hidden inputs ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE '<input type="hidden"[^>]*>'

curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3111/ \
  -F '$ACTION_REF_1=' \
  -F '$ACTION_1:0={"id":"60ea3f3716618351936f2f68a3db8008fd4efa0a8f","bound":"$@1"}' \
  -F '$ACTION_1:1=[{}]' \
  -F '$ACTION_KEY=k3ad77def66790c90177a486c02a6a7bc' \
  -F 'title=Piranesi' -F 'author=Susanna Clarke' -F 'notes=Halls and statues; loved it.' \
  | grep -iE '^HTTP|^x-action-redirect|^location'; echo "=== store ==="; cat data/books.json

ID=9e544397-33cf-41d1-a1f7-6922d1943cc0
echo "=== detail page (fresh session, no cookies) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/books/$ID | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>|book-title">[^<]*|book-author">[^<]*|Mark as finished|Copy link|Halls and statues[^<]*'
echo "=== finish form hidden fields ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/books/$ID | grep -oE '<form[^>]*>[^!]{0,400}' | head -3

ID=9e544397-33cf-41d1-a1f7-6922d1943cc0
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'finish -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' -X POST http://localhost:3111/books/$ID \
  -F '$ACTION_ID_403b3243e8ce7f4aff7f104efebf019c57a7dbc356=' -F "id=$ID"
echo "=== store ==="; cat data/books.json | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).map(b=>[b.title,b.status,b.finishedAt])))"
echo "=== home page ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE 'Currently reading|Finished|Nothing on the go[^<"]*|No finished books yet|class="title">[^<]*'
echo "=== unknown book id ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3111/books/does-not-exist

ID=9e544397-33cf-41d1-a1f7-6922d1943cc0
NOTES_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3111/books/$ID | grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_40c9[a-f0-9]*' | head -1)
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "notes save -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3111/books/$ID -F "$NOTES_ID=" -F "id=$ID" -F 'notes=Second pass: even better.'
node -e "console.log('notes now:', JSON.stringify(require('./data/books.json')[0].notes))"

# add a second book so both shelves have something
KEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE 'ACTION_KEY" value="[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f3)
curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3111/ -F '$ACTION_REF_1=' \
  -F '$ACTION_1:0={"id":"60ea3f3716618351936f2f68a3db8008fd4efa0a8f","bound":"$@1"}' \
  -F '$ACTION_1:1=[{}]' -F "\$ACTION_KEY=$KEY" \
  -F 'title=The Left Hand of Darkness' -F 'author=Ursula K. Le Guin'
echo "--- restarting server ---"
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 2
(npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3112/ && break; sleep 1; done
echo "after restart, home page shows:"
curl -s http://localhost:3112/ | grep -oE 'Currently reading|^Finished|class="title">[^<]*|class="author"> — [^<]*' | head -8
node -e "console.log(require('./data/books.json').map(b=>b.title+' / '+b.status))"

(setsid npx next start -p 3113 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3113/ && break; sleep 1; done
echo "=== home page after restart ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3113/ | sed -e 's/<[^>]*>/|/g' | tr -s '|' '\n' | grep -nE 'Currently reading|Finished|Piranesi|Left Hand|Nothing on|No finished' | head
pkill -f next-server >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf /workspace/data; echo cleaned; ls /workspace
ls /workspace; echo "---"; ls /workspace/data 2>&1; curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3113/ 2>&1
rm -rf /workspace/data && ls /workspace && git -C /workspace status --short
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -6; echo "=== files ==="; find /workspace -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' -not -path '*__agent_eval__*' | sort
